question.text: The surface of water in a water tank of cross section area <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>750</mn><mo> </mo><msup><mi>cm</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> on the top of a house is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>h</mi><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>. above the tap level. The speed of water coming out through the tap of cross section area <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>500</mn><mo> </mo><msup><mi>mm</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>30</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. At that instant, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi>h</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> will be ______.

solution.text:
Using continuity equation

A1v1=A2v2

We have, 

750×10-4v1=500×10-6×0.3

v1=500×3×10-3750 

=2×10-3 m s-1

Thus, dhdt=-2×10-3 m s-1

Hence, the value of x=2.
